prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Try these quick gestures to interact with your pet anytime on your screen.", "Right-click pet for settings | Double-click to talk | Drag to move across monitors"]
1: ["Next: Desktop Controls", "Pet Control Shortcuts", "Press Alt+P anytime to summon or hide your pet. Right-click your pet to open options.", "Got It!"]
2: ["Customize Companion Style", "Personalize Your Companion", "Choose color themes and personality traits before creating your adoption certificate.", "Confirm Companion Style"]
3: ["Save Your Companion to Cloud", "Sign in now to sync your new pet across devices and ensure your companion state is never lost."]
4: ["Secure Your Companion in the Cloud", "Sign in to automatically back up your pet, state, and accessories. Logging in restores any existing pet registered to your account.", "Existing user? Sign in with your original account to restore your pet automatically."]
5: ["If your pet does not appear on screen immediately, check your system tray icon or display permission settings."]
6: ["Rendering Desktop Pet...", "Initializing screen overlay, graphics hooks, and desktop companion animations."]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your adopted pet includes a free Starter Toy & Accessories Bundle.", "Free Starter Accessory Pack Unlocked"]
8: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Choose an instant starter pet or create a fully customized desktop companion.", "Select Journey"]
9: ["Your pet lives in your system tray! Click the desktop tray icon anytime to bring your companion to the front."]
